plainTranslation: A's growth meets B's drive. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.
note: Synced from authored synastry bundle synastry-authored__19_ (2).json.
summaryDeep: Their confidence, encouragement, and appetite for possibility sit right on top of your drive, timing, and willingness to act. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: The downside is just as obvious: you can talk each other into things that are not actually good ideas. Confidence is not a plan. Enthusiasm is not preparation. You may assume everything will work out because it feels exciting to believe it will.
advice: This connection is strongest when you pair courage with common sense. Go for it. Just know what you are getting into first.
